analysis.amplitude-square: Normalized clock responses at amplitudes 0.002,0.004,0.008 differ by <5%; weak log slope within 0.1 of 2.
analysis.common-markers: Each preparation has >=5 positive-going ticks, same count and ordered uniquely paired ticks with absolute shift <quarter frozen period; predicted tick shifts within max(10% measured shift,1e-5 cycles).
analysis.conservation: Maximum charge relative error <1e-5 and matched total-energy residual / initial incident energy <1% across grids; discrete Hamiltonian, no sponge in t<=100.
analysis.counter-match: Same frozen discrepancy criteria on concentric inward/outward packet control at amplitude 0.004.
analysis.frozen-inputs: All input SHA-256 values match frozen Test 6 profiles and eigenmodes.
analysis.numerical-controls: Mesh, time and box relative L2 clock-difference errors each <5%; signal RMS >1e-12 m or unresolved.
analysis.prediction-first: Every saved prediction hash and prediction-lock event precedes every receiver evolution completion, with no nonlinear evolution before lock in registered worker.
analysis.response-match: L2 single-packet prediction discrepancy <5% and <5 times (mesh + time + box relative response error + 0.002 declared response-error floor).
analysis.sign-even: L2 sign-odd clock difference / sign-even difference <1e-5 for each grid, using +/-0.004.
